title: Household Income & Savings
headline_read: Household cushions are thin — savings or real incomes are stretched.

indicators.title: Personal Saving Rate
indicators.context: The share of after-tax income households save each month. A thin saving rate means no shock absorber — the historical norm is 5-8%.
indicators.read: Households are saving just 2.7% of income — almost no cushion left.

indicators.title: Real Disposable Income · year-over-year
indicators.context: After-tax household income adjusted for inflation. When it falls, spending can only be sustained by savings or debt — and both run out.
indicators.read: Real income is up 0.5% from a year ago — purchasing power is growing.

indicators.title: Household Net Worth · year-over-year
indicators.context: Everything households own minus everything they owe (quarterly). Driven by home prices and markets — the wealth effect behind spending confidence.
indicators.read: Household net worth is growing 8.0% a year.
